title: Source: 49ers agree to terms with ex-Steelers, Broncos punter Corliss Waitman

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Source: 49ers agree to terms with ex-Steelers, Broncos punter Corliss Waitman
sources.description: The San Francisco 49ers have agreed to terms with punter Corliss Waitman, a source confirmed to NBC Sports Bay Area's Matt Maiocco on Saturday.
